# 03. Implementation Map: Entalpa SaaS Foundations

**Project Scope:** This document provides the high-level architectural mapping for the SaaS platform, ensuring that the infrastructure and core logic fulfill the technical requirements generated by the Entalpa engine.

---

## Architectural Core

- **Multi-tenant Workspace Management:** - Full isolation of personal and team workspaces with dedicated storage and settings.
    - Hierarchical resource organization including naming, color-coding, and folder structures.
    - Integrated search functionality across metadata and tags.
- **Identity & Authentication:** - Centralized identity management supporting email/password registration and OAuth.
    - Strict password complexity enforcement and session management with 30-minute inactivity timeouts.
    - Optional Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) via TOTP or SMS.
- **Global Financial Operations:** - Integration with a Merchant of Record (MoR) or automated tax engine to handle VAT, GST, and sales tax across all jurisdictions.
    - Automatic tax rate updates and generation of tax-compliant invoices.

## Security, Privacy & Compliance

- **Data Protection:** - Mandatory encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3+) for all communications.
    - Input validation and sanitization on all endpoints to prevent SQLi and XSS attacks.
- **Audit & Monitoring:** - Comprehensive audit logging for all authentication attempts, permission changes, and data access.
    - Real-time rate limiting (100 req/min/user) to mitigate brute-force and resource exhaustion.
- **Regulatory Compliance:** - Full support for GDPR/CCPA, including automated account deletion within 30 days and data portability via JSON/CSV export.

## Operational Excellence

- **Performance & Scalability:** - Target page load times under 2 seconds for 95% of requests.
    - Infrastructure designed to scale to 10,000 concurrent users without performance degradation.
- **Availability & Continuity:** - Guaranteed 99.5% monthly uptime with automated daily backups stored off-site.
    - Documented Recovery Time Objective (RTO) of 4 hours and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 24 hours.

## Subscription & Feature Gating

- **Tiered Access Control:** - Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) supporting Owner, Admin, Member, and Viewer roles.
    - Automated enforcement of feature limits based on at least three subscription tiers (e.g., Basic, Pro, Enterprise).
- **Billing Logic:** - Support for monthly/annual recurring billing cycles with automated failure handling and grace periods.
    - Real-time proration for subscription upgrades and downgrades.
